verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident-management page claims Google and Outlook calendar integration (docs-25) and says on-call schedules can be kept in a shared Google calendar (docs-49). That suggests calendar sync exists, but the evidence never describes a per-user subscribable feed (iCal/ICS URL) that pushes an engineer's own shifts to their personal calendar. The shared-calendar mention may describe schedules flowing into Better Stack rather than out of it. Missing for 10: explicit personal iCal/ICS feed of an individual's shifts, documentation of sync direction and override/cover updates reflected in the feed, independent or hands-on corroboration.
